subject.title: Telegram voice message delayed ~15 minutes before agent dispatch, then run aborts

question: What should Telegram do when a voice-message update is much older than dispatch time or when a direct-message voice turn aborts without any final reply?
rationale: The source-backed gaps are real, but the threshold, restart/alert behavior, retry semantics, and direct-message fallback text are user-visible policy choices that can affect valid delayed work and private conversations.

options.title: Define a narrow latency and fallback policy
options.body: Specify the source-date threshold, diagnostics, restart/alert behavior, and direct-message fallback semantics, then implement that exact policy with regression and live Telegram proof.

options.title: Limit this issue to diagnostics first
options.body: Add source-date latency logging only and leave restart behavior and user-visible fallback to a separate maintainer-approved follow-up.

options.title: Wait for a live repro before policy
options.body: Keep the issue open under live-repro review until a maintainer can capture the exact Telegram voice delay and abort path on current main.

recommendation.title: Define a narrow latency and fallback policy
recommendation.body: Specify the source-date threshold, diagnostics, restart/alert behavior, and direct-message fallback semantics, then implement that exact policy with regression and live Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent Telegram polling and spool reliability history is closest to the liveness/recovery policy boundary this issue needs.
